Hausa: Raguwar qarfin ƙasa babban cikas ne ga noman amfanin gona a yankin kudu da hamadar Sahara.

English: The positive effect of biochar and compost applications on soil fertility has been reported by many authors.
Luganda: Abawandiisi bangi boolese ebirungi ebiva mu kukozesa ebyandayanda ne nnakavundira mu kugimusa ettaka.

Zulu: Umthelela omuhle wokufakwa kwe-biochar nomquba ekuvundeni kwenhlabathi ubikwe ababhali abaningi.
Hausa: Marubuta da dama sun ba da rahoton ingantaccen tasirin gawayi da takin ƙasa akan amfanin ƙasa.
Northern Sotho: Go ba le mohola ga tšhomišo ya payotšha le kompose go nontšheng mabu go begilwe ke bangwadi ba bantši.
Amharic: ባዮቻር እና ማዳበሪያን መጨመር በአፈር ለምነት ላይ አሉታዊ ተጽእኖ እንዳለው በብዙ ጸሃፊዎች ተዘግቧል፡፡

English: In this study, a 30-day laboratory incubation experiment was done using 120 g samples each of a Haplic acrisol amended with corn cob biochar (cbio), rice husk biochar (rbio), coconut husk biochar (coco300 and coco700) or poultry manure compost (compost); and co- composted rice husk biochar (rcocomp) or co-composted corn cob biochar (cococomp) at rates of 1 % w/w amendment: soil, respectively.
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza kuno, okugeseza okwalimu okubikka ebirobozo okumala ennaku 30 kwakolebwa nga buli kirondobe kirimu 120 g, ebyandayanda by’ebikongoliro, ebyandayanda by’obukuta bw’omuceere, ebyandayanda by’obukuta bw’ebinazi (coco300 ne coco700) oba nnakavundira akoleddwa mu bubi bw’ebinyonyi; ne nnakavundira w’ebyandayanda by’obukuta bw’omuceere oba nnakavundira w’ebyandayanda by’ebikongoliro nga buli kimu kiteereddwamu obungi bwa kitundu (cococomp) 1% n’eky’ettaka.
Yoruba: Nínú iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí, ìṣèwádìí ọjọ́ 30 wáyé nínú láàbù nípa lílo àpẹẹrẹ Haplic Acrisol 120 g pẹ̀lú ṣùkùrù àgbàdo (cbio), èpo ìrẹsì (rbio), èpo àgbọn (coco300 and coco700) tàbí àwọn ohun ajílẹ̀ ní iyẹ 1% w/w alátúnṣe: ilẹ̀, lọ́lọ́kan-ò-jọ̀kan.
Zulu: Kulolu cwaningo, kuhlolisiswe ukufukamela kwaselebhorethri kwesinsuku ezingu-30 kusetshenziswa amasampula angu-120 g e-Haplic acrisol ihlanganiswe ne-biochar (cbio) yamahleza, ibiochar yamakhoba elayisi (rbio), ibiochar yamakhoba kakhokhonthi (coco300 and coco700) noma umquba wezinkukhu (compost); nomquba we-biocha yamakhoba elayisi(rcocomp) noma umquba webiochar yamahleza (cococomp) enanini lokuchitshiyelwa  lika 1% w/w: ngokulandelana kwenhlabathi.
Hausa: A wannan binciken, an yi gwajin xakin gwaji na kwanaki 30 ta hanyar amfani da samfuran 120 g na ko wanne na Haplic acrisol wanda aka gyara da gawayin ciyawar masara (cbio), gawayin vawon shinkafa (rbio), gawayin vawon kwakwa (coco300 da coco700) ko takin kaji (taki); da gawayin ruvavven vawon shinkafa (rcocomp) ko gawayin ciyawar masara (cococomp) a matakin gyara na 1% w/w: ƙasa, bi da bi.
Northern Sotho: Ka dinyakišišong tše, go dirilwe diteko tša go alametša tša laporathori tša matšatši a 30 go šomišwa disampole tša 120 g tša ye nngwe le ye nngwe ya Haplic acrisol yeo e fetotšwego ka payotšha ya mekgokgothi ya lefela (cbio), payotšha ya makgapetla a raese (rbio), payotšha ya makgapetla a khokhonate (coco300 le coco700) goba kompose ya mmutedi wa dikgogo (kompose); le payotšha ya motswako wa makgapetla a raese le kompose (rcocomp) goba payotšha ya motswako wa mekgokgothi ya lefela le kompose (cococomp) ka dikelo tša diphetošo tše 1 % w/w: go akaretšwa le mabu.
Amharic: በዚህ ጥናት 120ግ ናሙናዎችን በመጠቀም የ30 ቀን በላብራቶሪ የመቀፍቀፍ ሙከራ ተደርጓል፡፡  ለዚህም በበቆሎ እሸት ባዮቻር (በባዮ)፣ በሩዝ ቅርፊት ባዮቻር  (ሩባዩ)፣ በኮኮናት ቅርፊት ባዮቻር  (ኮኮ300 እና ኮኮ700) ወይም በዶሮ እርባታ ብስባሽ ማዳበሪያ  (ማዳበሪያ) እና በህብረት ማዳበሪያ የሩዝ ቅርፊት ባዮቻር (rcocomp) ወይም በህብረት ማዳበሪያ የበቆሎ እሸት ባዮቻር (cococomp) የተሻሻለ ሃፒሊክ አርኪሶል  በቅደም ተከተል በ 1% w/w ማሻሻያ፡አፈር

English: Other treatments in the study were combined poultry manure compost and corn cob biochar or rice husk biochar (1 % compost + 1% biochar: 1% soil w/w), respectively, to examine their effects on basal soil respiration, soil pH; soil microbial carbon; cation exchange capacity; total organic carbon, total nitrogen and available nitrogen concentration.
Luganda: Ebirala ebyakolebwako mu kunoonyereza ye nnakavundira akolebwa mu bubi bw’ebinyonyi n’byandayanda by’ebikongoliro oba ebyandayanda by’obukuta bw’omuceere (1% ekya nnakavundira + 1% eky’ebyandayanda: 1% eky’ettaka) okusobola okwekaliriza engeri gye bikosaamu okussa kw’ettaka, pH y’ettaka; kaboni w’ettaka ava mu buwuka, omugatte gw’omukka gwa nitrogen n’ensaasaana ya nitrogen eriwo.
Yoruba: Àwọn ohun mìíràn nínú ìwádìí náà ni àpapọ̀ ajílẹ̀ àti ṣùkùrù àgbàdo tàbí èpo ìrẹsì (1 % compost + 1% èédú: 1% soil w/w), lọ́lọ́kan-ò-jọ̀kan, láti lè wo ìṣe wọn lórí ìmí ilẹ̀ básálì, ilẹ̀ pH; kábọ́ọ̀nù ilẹ̀; ìpàrọ̀ kábọ́ọ̀nù; àpapọ̀ kábọ́ọ̀nù tó jíire, àpapọ̀ náítírójínì àti ìgbápọ̀ nahítírójínì.
Zulu: Kolunye uhla lwalolu cwaningo kwahlanganiswa umquba wezinkukhu ne-biochar yamahleza noma yamakhoba elayisi (1 % compost + 1% biochar: 1% soil w/w), ngokulandelana, ukuhlola umthelela wawo ekuphefumuleni kwenhlabathi, i-pH yenhlabathi; ikhaboni e-microbial enhlabathi; umthamo wokushintshana kwama-cation; ikhaboni e-organic ephelele; i-nitrogen ephelele nobukhona be-nitrogen eningi.
Hausa: Wasu gwajejen kan jinyar qasa a cikin binciken sun haɗa da takin kaji da gawayin masara ko vawon shinkafa (1% taki + 1% gawayi: 1% ƙasa w/w), bi da bi, don binciko tasirinsu a kan numfashin ƙasa, pH na ƙasa; qwayar halittar ƙasa; iyawa musaya; jimlar qwayoyin kabon, jimlar sinadarin niturogin da abubuwan da ake samu na niturogin.
Northern Sotho: Metswako ye dingwe ka dinyakišišong e bile motswako wa payotšha ya kompose ya mmutedi wa dikgogo le mekgokgothi ya lefela goba payotšha ya makgapetla a raese (kompose ya 1 % + payotšha ya 1%: mabu a 1% w/w), go lekodišiša diabe tša tšona godimo ga go hema moya ga mabu a pasale, pH ya mabu; kelo ya khapone ya maekhropiale mabung; bogolo bja phetošetšano ya kheišene; kelo ya methopo ya khapone, kelo ya naetrotšene le kelo ya naetrotšene ye e lego gona.
Amharic: በጥናቱ የዋሉ ሌሎች ህክምናዎች የሚከተሉት ናቸው፡ የዶሮ እርባታ ብስበባሽ ማዳበሪያ እና የበቆሎ እሸት ባዮቻር ወየም የሩዝ ቅርፊት ባዮቻር ( በቅደም ተከተል 1% ማዳበሪያ + 1% ባዮቻር፡ 1% አፈር w/w) ፡፡ ይህም በመሰረታዊ የአፈር ትንፈሳ ላይ ያላቸውን ተጽእኖ ለመመርመር ፣ በአፈር ፒኤች፣ የአፈር ረቂቅ ተህዋሲያን ካርቦን፣ የካታዩን የልውውጥ አቅም፣ ጠቀልላላ ኦርጋኒክ ካርቦን እና ጠቅላላ ናይትሮጅን እና የሚገኘው የናይትሮጅን ውፍረታ፡፡

English: Biochar and compost applied solely or together, and composted biochar increased soil pH by 0.28–2.29 pH units compared to the un-amended control.
Luganda: Ebyandayanda ne nnakavundira nga buli kimu kikozeseddwa kyokka oba nga bikozeseddwa wamu ne nnakavundira w’ebyandayanda byatumbula pH y’ettaka okuva ku bitundu 0.28-2.29 bw’ogeraageranya n’eddala eritali litabule.
Yoruba: Èédú àti ajílẹ̀ ta papọ̀ tàbí ta lò lọ́tọ́ọ̀tọ̀, àti èédú ń ṣe ìkúnwọ́ sí ilẹ̀ pẹ̀lú 0.28 sí 2.29 pH ní àfiwé pẹ̀lú ìdarí ti a ò túnṣe.
Zulu: I-Biochar nomquba okufakwa ngakodwana noma ndawonye, nomquba we-biochar kunyuse i-pH yenhlabathi ngamayunithi e-pH angu 0.28-2.29 uma kuqhathaniswa nengeziwanga lutho.
Hausa: Gawayi da takin da aka yi amfani da su kawai ko tare, da gawayin takin ya ƙara pH na ƙasa da 0.28-2.29 pH idan aka kwatanta da qasar da ba a gyara ba.
Northern Sotho: Payotšha le kompose tše di dirišitšwego di le noši goba di hlakantšwego, le payotšha ye e tswakilwego ka kompose di okeditše pH ya mabu ka diyuniti tše 0.28–2.29 pH ge go bapetšwa le sampole yeo e sa fetošwago.
Amharic: ካልተሻሻለው የመቆጣጠሪያ  ናሙና ጋር ሲነጻጸር ባዮቻር እና ማዳበሪያ በተናጥል ወይም በአንድላይ ሲጨመሩ እና የዳበረ ባዮቻር የአፈርን ፒኤች ከ0.28 ወደ 2.29 የፒኤች ክፍሎች ከፍ አድርገውታል፡፡

English: Basal respiration from the sole compost or composted rice husk, or corn cob biochar or combined biochar and compost were higher than the un-amended control, which was similar to that from the biochar only treatments.
Luganda: Okussa okusookerwako okuva mu nnakavundira yekka/nnakavundira w’obukuta bw’omuceere/ebyandayanda by’ebikongoliro oba ekintabule ky’ebyandayanda ne nnakavundira kwali waggulu okusinga ebitali bitabule, okufaanana n’okwo okwava mu byandayanda byokka.
Yoruba: Ìmí básálì láti ìdí ajílẹ̀ tàbí èpo ìrẹsì, tàbí ṣùkùrù àgbàdo tàbí àpapọ̀ ajílẹ̀ pọ̀ ju èyí tí ìdarí ti a ò túnṣe ko sí fún, léyìí tó jọ èyí tí ajílẹ̀ nìkán wà fún lọ.
Zulu: Ukuphefumula okuvela emqubeni noma emqubeni wamakhoba elayisi, noma i-biochar yamahleza noma ehlanganisiwe nomquba kubephezulu kunalokhu okungathintwga, okufane nalokho okufakwe i-biochar yodwa.
Hausa: Numfashin qasa da ke fitowa daga takin da aka yi da takin shinkafa ko takin masara, ko haɗaɗɗen gawayi da takin sun fi ƙarfi kan wanda ba a gyara ba, wanda yayi kama da na gawayi kawai.
Northern Sotho: Go hema moya ga pasale go tšwa go kompose ye e sa hlakanywago goba makgapetla a raese a go tswakwa ka kompose, goba payotšha ya mekgokgothi ya lefela goba payotšha ya mohlakanelwa le kompose di be di feta sampole yeo e sa fetošwago, yeo e bego e swana le yeo e tšwago go metswako ya payotšha fela.
Amharic: ከብቸኛ ማዳበሪያ መሰረታዊ ትንፈሰ ወይም ከዳበረ የሩዝ ቅርፊት ወይም ከበቆሎ እሸት ባዮቻር ወይም ከተቀላቀለ ባዮቻር እና ማዳበሪያ ካልተሻሻለው የመቆጣጠሪያ ናሙና ጋር ሲነጻጸር ከፍተኛ ነበር፡፡ ይህ ደግሞ ባዮቻርን ብቻ ከተጠቀመው ህክምና ጋር ይመሳሰል ነበር፡፡

English: TOC in the sole compost and combined corn cob biochar and compost treatments were up to 37% and 117% higher, respectively, than the control.
Luganda: Ensaasaana ya kaboni mu mu nnakavundira n’ekintabule ky’ebyandayanda ne nnakavundira yayambuka n’etuuka ku bitundu 37% n’ebitundu 117% okusinga eritaatabulwamu kintu kyonna.
Yoruba: TOC ni ajílẹ̀ gbòógì àti àpapọ̀ ṣùkùrù àgbàdo àti àtúnṣe ajílẹ̀ tó ìwọn 37% àti 117% ju ètí tí à ń darí lọ.
Zulu: I-TOC esemqubeni wodwa nakwi-biochar yamahleza nalaokufakwekhona umquba inyuke ngo 37% no 117%, ngokulanelana, kunale ongenziwanga lutho.
Hausa: TOC a cikin takin da ba gauraya ba da wanda aka haɗa da gawayin masara, wanda aka yi wa jiyya sun fi wand ba a yi wa jinya ba da 37% da 117%, bi da bi.
Northern Sotho: TOC ka go kompose ye e dirišitšwego di le noši le payotšha ya metswako ya mekgokgothi ya lefela le kompose di be di hlatlogetše godimo go fihla go 37% le go 117%, go feta taolo.
Amharic: በብቸኛ ማዳበሪያ እና በተቀላቀለ የበቆሎ እሸት ባዮቻር  እና የማዳበሪያ ህክምና ውስጥ ያለው TOC ከመቆጣጠሪያ ናሙናው ጋር ሲነጻጸር በቅደም ተከተል 37% እና 117% ከፍ ያለ ነበር፡፡

English: Combined application of rice husk biochar and compost increased MBC by 132% while sole compost addition increased MBC by 247%, respectively, compared to the control.
Luganda: Okutabika ebyandayanda by’obukuta bw’omuceere ne nnakavundira kwatumbula ensaasaana y’obuwuka bw’omu ttaka n’ebitundu 132% ate ng’okutabikamu nnakavundira yekka kwatumbula ensaasaana yaabwo n’ebitundu 247% bw’ogeraageranya n’eritaatabulwamu kintu kyonna.
Yoruba: Àpapọ̀ èpo ìresì àti ijílẹ̀ ṣe àfikún MBC pẹ̀lú iwọn 132% nígba tí ìlo ajilẹ̀ nìkan ṣe àfikún pẹ̀lú 247% lólọ́kan-ò-jọ̀kan, ni àfiwé pẹ̀lú ìdarí.
Zulu: Ukufakwa kwe-biochar yamakhoba elayisi exutshwe nomquba kukhuphule i-MBC ngo-132% ngesikhathi umquba wodwa ukhuphule i-MBC ngo-247%, ngokulandelana, uma kuqhathaniswa nenhlabathi engeziwanga lutho.
Hausa: Haɗe-haɗen amfani da gawayin vawon shinkafa da taki ya ƙara MBC da 132% yayin da ƙarin takin da aka haɗa ya qara MBC da 247%, bi da bi, idan aka kwatanta da wanda ba sarrafa ba.

Zulu: Abacwaningi bakhiqise ibiochar ngamahleza, ukhokhonathi namakhoba elayisi besebenzisa ipyrolysis, ebandakanya ukushiswa kwezinto eziphilayo endaweni engenawo umoya onempilo, eshiswa ngo-450 °C eziko elakhwe endaweni.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun samar da gawayi daga ciyawar masara, kwakwa da vawon shinkafa ta hanyar amfani da qonasu, wato pyrolysis, wanda ya haxa da xumama kwayoyin halitta a yanayin da ba iskar, a 450 °C a cikin tukunyar gargajiya.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba tšweleditše dipayotšha tša mekgokgothi ya lefela, tša khokhonate le tša makgapetla ya raese ka tšhomišo ya phaerolaesese, ye e akareditšego go fišwa ga methopo ya tlhago moo go se nago oksitšene, ka 450 °C go obene ye e tšweleditšwego ka nageng.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ግይታዊ ፍርሰትን በመጠቀም ኦክሲጅን በሌለበት ጊዜ ኦርጋኒክ ቁስ አካልን በ450 ዲ.ሴ በሃገር ውስጥ በተመረተ ምድጃ በማሞቅ የበቆሎ እሸት፣ የኮኮናት እና የሩዝ ቅርፊት ባዮቻርን አምርተዋል፡፡

English: The researchers produced coconut husk biochar using pyrolysis at 300 °C and at 700 °C.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baakola ebyandayanda okuva mu bukuta bw’ebinazi nga babwokyera ku bbugumu lya 300 °C ne 700 °C.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùṣèwádìí náà ṣẹ̀dá èpo àgbọn nípa lílo ìgékuru látara ìgbóná ní 300 °C àti ní 700 °C.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bakhiqize ibiochar yamakhoba akhokhonathi besebenzisa i-pyrolysis eshiswe ngo 300 °C nango 700 °C.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun samar da gawayin kwakwa ta hanyar qonasu a 300 °C da kuma a 700 °C.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba tšweleditše payotšha ya makgapetla a khokhonate ka tšhomišo ya phaerolaesese ka 300 °C le ka 700 °C.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ግይታዊ ፍርሰትን በመጠቀም የኮኮናት ቅርፊት ባዮቻርን በ300 እና በ700 ዲ.ሴ አምርተዋል፡፡

English: The researchers then incubated soil samples mixed with the biochars for 30 days.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza oluvannyuma baabikka ettaka eryalondobwa nga ligattiddwamu ebyandayanda okumala 30 amakumi asatu.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùṣèwadìí náà sì ṣe ìgbé-sí-ìgò àwon àpẹẹrẹ iyẹ̀pẹ̀ tí a ti dàpọ̀ p̀ẹlú èédú fún ọgbọ̀n (30) ọjọ́.
Zulu: Abacwaningi babe sebefukamela amasampula enhlabathi ahlanganiswe ne-biochar amalanga angu-30.
Hausa: Daga nan ne masu binciken suka samar da samfuran ƙasa da aka gauraye da kwayoyin halitta na tsawon kwanaki 30.
Northern Sotho: Ke moka banyakišiši ba alameditše disampole tša mabu tše di hlakantšwego le dipayotšha tekano ya matšatši a 30.
Amharic: ከዛ ተመራማሪዎቹ ከባዮቻር ጋር የተደባለቁ የአፈር ናሙናዎችን ለ30 ቀናት ቀፍቅፈዋል፡፡

English: Each sample contained specially prepared soil called Haplic acrisol, which was mixed with different combinations of biochars made from corn cob, rice husk or coconut husk, and a poultry manure compost.
Luganda: Buli kirondobe kyalimu ettaka ery’enjawulo eryagattibwamu ebintabule by’ebyandayanda eby’enjawulo ebikoleddwa mu bikongoliro, obukuta bw’omuceere oba mu bukuta bw’ebinazi wamu ne nnakavundira akoleddwa mu bubi bw’ebinyonyi.
Yoruba: Àpẹẹrẹ lọ́lọ́kan-ò-jọ̀kan ló ní àkànṣe iyẹ̀pẹ̀ tí à ń pè ní Haplic Acrisol, èyí tí a pò pọ̀ mọ́ oríṣiríṣi èédú táa ṣe látara ṣùkùrù àgbàdo, èpo ìrẹsì tàbí èpo àgbọn, àti ìgbẹ́ àwọn adìyẹ.
Zulu: Amasampula abequkethe inhlabathi elungiswe ngekhethelo ebizwa nge Haplic acrisol, ehlanganiswe nengxube yema-biochars akhiwe ngamahleza, amakhoba elayisi noma akhokhonathi, nomanyolo womquba wezinkukhu.
Hausa: Ko wane samfurin ya ƙunshi ƙasa da aka shirya ta musamman mai suna Haplic acrisol, wanda aka haɗa da nau'ukan gawayi dabam-dabam da aka yi daga masara, vawon shinkafa ko na kwakwa, da takin kaji.
Northern Sotho: Sampole ye nngwe le ye nngwe e be e na le mabu ao a beakantšwego ka tsela ya go ikgetha ao a bitšwago Haplic acrisol, ao a bego a hlakantšwe le metswako ya go fapafapana ya dipayotšha tše di dirilwego ka mekgokgothi ya lefela, makgapetla a raese goba makgapetla a khokhonate, le kompose ya mmutedi wa dikgogo.
Amharic: ሁሉም ናሙናዎች በጥንቃቄ የተዘጋጀ እና ሃፕሊክ አክሪሶል የተሰኘ አፈር ይዘው ነበር፡፡ ይህም ከተለያዩ ከበቆሎ እሸት፣ ከሩዝ እና ከኮኮናት ቅርፊት እና ከዶሮ እርባታ ብስባሽ ማዳበሪያ የተሰሩ የባዮቻር ድብልቆች ጋር የተቀላቀለ ነበር፡፡

English: Other samples contained a mix of soil and poultry manure compost , with rice husk biochar, and corn cob biochar, respectively.
Luganda: Ebirondobe ebirala byalimu ettaka nga ligattiddwamu nnakavundira akoleddwa mu bubi bw’ebisolo, ebyandayanda ebikoleddwa mu bukuta bw’omuceere n’ebyo ebikoleddwa mu bikongoliro.
Yoruba: Àwọn àgbàálẹ̀ àpẹẹrẹ mìíràn ní àpapọ̀ iyẹ̀pẹ̀ àti ajílẹ̀ nǹkan ọ̀sìn, pẹ̀lú èpo ìrẹsì, àti sùkùrù àgbàdo.
Zulu: Amanye amasampula abequkethe ingxube yenhlabathi nomquba wezinkukhu, ane-biochar yamakhoba elayisi, ne-biochar yamahleza.
Hausa: Sauran samfurori sun ƙunshi cakuxa ƙasa da takin kaji, tare da vawon shinkafa, da ƙwayar masara, bi da bi.
Northern Sotho: Disampole tše dingwe di be di na le motswako wa mabu le kompose ya mmutedi wa dikgogo, le payotšha ya makgapetla a raese, gammogo le payotšha ya mekgokgothi ya lefela.
Amharic: ሌሎች ናሙናዎች ደግሞ የዶሮ እርባታ ብስባሽ ማዳበሪያ እና የአፈር ድብልቅን ከሩዝ ቅርፊት ባዮቻር እና ከበቆሎ እሸት ባዮቻር ጋር በቅደም ተከተል ይዘው ነበር፡፡

English: Each of the samples contained 1 % compost, 1% for each biochar, so that the researchers could investigate the effect of each mixture on soil quality.
Luganda: Buli kirondobe kyalimu ekitundu 1% ekya nnakavundira n’ekitundu 1% ekya buli byandayanda kisobozese abanoonyereza okunoonyereza engeri buli kintabule gye kikosaamu obugimu bw’ettaka.
Yoruba: Ọ̀kọ̀ọ̀kan àwọn àpẹẹrẹ wọ̀nyí ní 1% ajílẹ̀ nínú, 1% fún èédù kọ̀ọ̀kan, kí àwọn olùṣèwádìí náà lẹ̀ sàyẹ̀wò ìṣe ìdàpọ̀ kọ̀ọ̀kan lóríi ìdára ilẹ̀ náà.
Zulu: Isampula ngalilodwa beliqukethe u-1% womquba, u1% we-biochar ngayinye, ukuze abacwaningi bakwazi ukuphenya umthelela wengxube ngayinye ezingeni lenhlabathi.
Hausa: Ko wane samfurin ya ƙunshi takin 1%, 1% na ko wane gawayi, domin masu binciken su bincika tasirin ko wane cakuxa a kan ingancin ƙasa.
Northern Sotho: Sampole ye nngwe le ye nngwe e be e na le 1% ya kompose, 1% ya payotšha ye nngwe le ye nngwe, gore banyakišiši ba kgone go lemoga seabe sa motswako o mongwe le o mongwe go boleng bja mabu.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ እያንዳንዱ ድብልቅ በአፈር ጥራት ላይ ያለውን ተጽእኖ ማጥናት እንዲችሉ ሁሉም ናሙናዎች 1 % ማዳበሪያ እና 1 % ባዮቻር ይዘው ነበር፡፡

English: The researchers found that adding biochar and compost to the soil, either separately or together, increased the pH value of the soil from 0.28–2.29 pH units, compared to unmixed soil.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baazuula nti okugatta ebyandayanda ne nnakavundira mu ttaka nga buli kimu kiteereddwamu kyokka oba nga biteereddwamu wamu, kyayongeza pH y’ettaka okuva ku 0.28-2.29 pH bw’ogeraageranya n’ettaka eritali litabike.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùṣèwádìí náà ri pé fífi èédú àti ajílẹ̀ sínú ilẹ̀ bóyá papọ̀ tàbí lọ́tọ́ọ̀tọ̀, máa ń ṣe ìfikún fún pH ilẹ̀ náà láti 0.28 sí 2.29 iye pH, ní àfiwé pẹ̀lú ilẹ̀ tí a kò ṣe ìdàpọ méjẹ́èjì sí.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathole ukuthi ukwengeza i-biochar nomquba enhlabathini, ngakodwa noma ndawonye, kunyuse i-pH yenhlabathi yasuka ku 0.28-2.29 wamaynithi e-pH, uma eqhathaniswa nenhlabathi engaxutshiwe.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun gano cewa ƙara gawayi da takin a cikin ƙasa, ko dai daban ko tare, yana ƙara ƙimar pH na ƙasa daga raka'a 0.28-2.29 pH, idan aka kwatanta da ƙasa mara gauraye.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba utollotše gore go tšhela payotšha le kompose mabung, di se tša kopanywa goba di kopantšwe, go okeditše boleng bja pH bja mabu go tloga go diyuniti tša pH tše 0.28–2.29, ge go bapetšwa le mabu ao a sego a hlakantšhwa.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ካልተቀላቀለ አፈር ጋር ሲነጻጸር፣ ባዮቻር እና ማዳበሪያ አፈር ውስጥ በተናጠል ወይም በአንድላይ መጨመር የአፈሩን የፒኤች መጠን ከ0.28 ወደ 2.29 የፒኤች ክፍሎች እንደሚያሳድገው ደርሰውበታል፡፡

English: An increase in pH means the soil became less acidic.
Luganda: Okweyongera mu pH y’ettaka kitegeeza nti olwo ettaka lyali lirimu asidi mutono.
Yoruba: Ìgbòòro pH túmọ̀ sí pé ilẹ̀ náà yóò dínkù ní ásíìdì.
Zulu: Ukunyuka kwe-pH kusho ukuthi inhlabathi iba ne-esidi encane.
Hausa: Ƙaruwar pH yana nufin asid ya ragu cikin ƙasar.
Northern Sotho: Koketšego ya pH e šupa gore go bile le phokotšego ya esiti mabung.
Amharic: ፒኤች ጨመረ ማለት የአፈሩ አሲዳማነት ቀነሰ ማለት ነው፡፡

English: The study found that basal respiration, or the minimum amount of carbon dioxide being released by the soil, increased when either compost alone was added, or when compost was mixed with rice husk, or corn cob biochar or combined biochars.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kwazuula nti obungi bw’omukka gwa carbon dioxide obusookerwako obufulumizibwa mu ttaka bweyongerako nga nnakavundira yekka agattiddwamu oba nga nnakavundira agattiddwamu ebyandayanda by’obukuta bw’omuceere/ebyandayanda ebikoleddwa mu bikongoliro oba ng’agattiddwa mu kintabule ky’ebyandayanda byombi.
Yoruba: Ìwádìí náà ri pé ipò ìmí básálì, tàbí iye ìmíjáde tó kéré jùlọ tí ilẹ̀ ń mú jáde, máa ń pọ̀ si ní a bá fi ajílẹ̀ nìkan sílẹ̀, tàbí tí a bá pa ajílẹ̀ pọ̀ mọ́ èpo ìrẹsì, tàbí ṣùkùrù àgbàdo àbí àpapọ̀ èédú.
Zulu: Ucwaningo luthole ukuthi ukuphefumula, noma inani elincane le-carbon dioxide elikhishwa inhlabathi, linyuke uma kufakwa umquba kuphela, noma uma umquba uhlanganiswa ne-biochar yamakhoba elayisi, yamahleza noma ama-biochar axutshiwe.
Hausa: Binciken ya gano cewa numfashin, ko kuma mafi qarancin sinadarin kabon da qasa ke fitarwa, yana karuwa ne idan aka haqa takin kaxai, ko kuma idan aka haxa takin da gawayin vawon shinkafa, ko na masara ko gawayin garwaye.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo di utollotše gore go hema ga pasale, goba kelo ya fasefase ya khapone-taeokesaete yeo e ntšwago ke mabu, e oketšegile ge go be go tšhelwa kompose e le noši, goba ge kompose e be e kopanywa le makgapetla a raese, goba payotšha ya mekgokgothi ya lefela goba dipayotšha tše di kopantšwego.
Amharic: ጥናቱ መሰረታዊ ትንፈሳ ወይም በአፈር የሚለቀቀው የካርቦን ዳዮክሳይድ መጠን ማዳበሪያ ለብቻው ወይም ማዳበሪያ ከሩዝ ቅርፊት ጋር ተቀላቅሎ ወይም የበቆሎ እሸት ባዮቻር እና ሌሎች ድብልቅ ባዮቻሮች ሲጨመርበት ከፍ እንደሚል አግኝቷል፡፡

English: The soil samples showed an increase in total organic carbon content of 37% when compost alone was used, and an increase of 117% when corn cob biochar was mixed with compost.
Luganda: Ebirondobe by’ettaka byayoleka okweyongera kwa kaboni kwa bitundu 37% nga nnakavundira yekka akozeseddwa n’okweyongera kwa kaboni kwa bitundu 117% ebyandayanda ebikoleddwa mu bikongoliro bwe byagattibwa mu nnakavundira.
Yoruba: Àgbàálẹ̀ àpẹẹrẹ iyẹ̀pẹ̀ ilẹ̀ náà fi hàn pé ìkúnwọ́ àpapọ̀ kábọ́ọ̀nù ilẹ̀ sí 37% nígbà tí a lo ajílẹ̀ nìkan, àti ìfikún 117% nígbà tí a pa ṣùkùrù àgbàdo pọ̀ mọ́ ajílẹ̀.
Zulu: Amasampula enhlabathi akhombise ikunyuka kwe-organic carbon content ngo 37% uma kusetshenziswa umquba kuphela, nokunyuka ngo 117% uma kuxutshwe i-biochar yamahleza nomquba.
Hausa: Samfurorin ƙasan sun nuna ƙaruwar jimlar snadarin kabon ɗin da ya kai 37% idan aka yi amfani da takin kaɗai, da ƙaruwar 117% idan aka gauraya gawayin masara da takin.
Northern Sotho: Disampole tša mabu di bontšhitše koketšego ya palomoka ya go ba gona ga methopo ya khapone ya 37% ge go be go šomišwa kompose e le noši, le koketšego ya 117% ge payotšha ya mekgokgothi ya lefela e be e kopanywa le kompose.
Amharic: የአፈር ናሙናዎቹ ማዳበሪያ ለብቻው ሲጨመርባቸው መላው የኦርጋኒክ ካርቦን ይዘታቸው የ37% እድገት አሳይቷል፤ ከማዳበሪያ ጋር የበቆሎ እሸት ባዮቻር ሲቀላቀል ደግሞ የ117% እድገት አምጥተዋል፡፡

English: The amount of microorganism activity increased by 132% where the soil had a mixture of compost and rice husk biochar, compared to an increase of 247% in soil samples that had compost alone.
Luganda: Omuwendo gw’obuwuka bw’omu ttaka gweyongera n’ebitundu 132% ng’ettaka lirimu ekintabule kya nnakavundira n’ebyandayanda ebikoleddwa mu bukuta bw’omuceere bw’ogeraageranya n’okulinnya kwa bitundu 247% mu birondobe by’ettaka ebyalimu nnakavundira yekka.
Yoruba: Ìṣe àwọn kòkòrò àìfojúrí gbèrú si pẹ̀lú 132% nibi tí ilẹ̀ náà ti ilẹ̀ ti ní àpòpọ ajílẹ̀ àti èpo ìresì, ní àfiwé pẹ̀lú ìgbèrú 247% nínú ilẹ̀ fún àwọn ilẹ̀ tó ní ajílẹ̀ nìkan.
Zulu: Inani lokusebenza kwama-microorganism kunyuke ngo 132% lapho inhlabathi uxutshwe nomquba ne-biochar yamakhoba elayisi, uma iqhathaniswa nokunyuka ngo 247% emasampuleni enhlabani abenomquba kuphela.
Hausa: Adadin motsin ƙwayoyin halitta ya karu da 132% inda ƙasa ke da cakuxar taki da gawayin vawon shinkafa, idan aka kwatanta da karuwar 247% a cikin samfuran ƙasa waɗanda ke da taki kawai.
Northern Sotho: Kelo ya mošomo wa ditwatši tše di ka se bonwego ka mahlo e oketšegile ka 132% moo mabu a kopantšwego le motswako wa kompose le payotšha ya makgapetla a raese, ge e bapetšwa le koketšego ya 247% go disampole tša mabu ao a bego a na le kompose fela.
Amharic: አፈሩ ማዳበሪያ ብቻ ካለው አፈር የ247% እድገት ጋር ሲነጻጸር፣ ማዳበሪያ እና የሩዝ ቅርፊት ባዮቻር ድብልቅ ሲጨመርበት የረቂቅ ተህዋስያን እንቅስቃሴ በ132% ጨምሯል፡፡

English: The results of this research show that it is possible to decrease soil acidity using biochar, which is easily and cheaply available.
Luganda: Ebyava mu kunoonyereza kuno biraga nti kisoboka okukendeeza asidi mu ttaka ng’okozesa ebyandayanda ebifunika mangu ate nga bya layisi.

English: This is in contrast to the alternative practice of liming the soil, which is costly and scarcely available to smallholder farmers in sub-Saharan Africa.
